name: Audience & Intent Triage
desc: Determines reader search intent and domain expertise level.
explain: Determines reader search intent and domain expertise level.
prompt: Triage target audience and search intent: Who is the reader? (Beginner, practitioner, executive). Is their intent informational, transactional, or comparative?

name: Thesis & Core Idea Sharpener
desc: Defines a single defensible, rigorous, and non-trivial thesis statement.
explain: Defines a single defensible, rigorous, and non-trivial thesis statement.
prompt: Sharpen the core thesis: What is the single defensible claim this article makes? Emphasize a distinct or contrarian angle rather than generic industry platitudes.

name: Critical Hook Extractor
desc: Designs compelling hooks that capture reader attention in the first 3 seconds.
explain: Designs compelling hooks that capture reader attention in the first 3 seconds.
prompt: Formulate 3 alternative introductory hooks: (a) A counter-intuitive statistic, (b) A conceptual paradox or provocative question, (c) A high-tension micro-case study.

name: Tone & Authority Calibrator
desc: Establishes the editorial voice (pragmatic, authoritative, analytical).
explain: Establishes the editorial voice (pragmatic, authoritative, analytical).
prompt: Calibrate editorial voice: Establish a senior editor tone that is deeply knowledgeable, grounded, and concise. Reject all marketing hype and superficial fluff.

name: Value Proposition Alignment
desc: Clarifies the concrete, actionable takeaways the reader walks away with.
explain: Clarifies the concrete, actionable takeaways the reader walks away with.
prompt: Answer the reader's question: 'What do I gain from reading this?': Define 3 concrete, high-leverage actionable takeaways delivered upon completion.

name: Content Angle Pivot
desc: Shifts a common subject into a distinct, defensible, and high-signal perspective.
explain: Shifts a common subject into a distinct, defensible, and high-signal perspective.
prompt: Pivot the editorial angle: Out of 100 typical articles on this topic, what overlooked or contrarian lens will this piece dissect to provide unique value?

name: Evidence Hierarchy Audit (BLOG.md)
desc: Tags all claims as SOLID, DIMINISHED, CONTESTED, UNKNOWN, or DEBUNKED.
explain: Tags all claims as SOLID, DIMINISHED, CONTESTED, UNKNOWN, or DEBUNKED.
prompt: Perform Evidence Hierarchy Audit (BLOG.md): Audit every factual claim and assign: [SOLID] (empirically proven), [DIMINISHED] (context-limited), [CONTESTED] (academic debate), [UNKNOWN] (insufficient data), or [DEBUNKED] (falsified).

name: Claim Verification Grid
desc: Backs abstract claims with concrete case studies, metrics, and benchmarks.
explain: Backs abstract claims with concrete case studies, metrics, and benchmarks.
prompt: Build a Claim Verification Grid: Match every conceptual premise with at least one verifiable empirical benchmark, production case study, or industry dataset.

name: Data & Citation Scrubber
desc: Purges outdated, unverified, or fabricated statistics with verified citations.
explain: Purges outdated, unverified, or fabricated statistics with verified citations.
prompt: Scrub citations and statistics: Eliminate vague phrases like 'studies show' or 'experts agree'. Replace them with exact source names, publication years, and methodological context.

name: Anecdotal Evidence Filter
desc: Prevents isolated stories from being misrepresented as systemic rules.
explain: Prevents isolated stories from being misrepresented as systemic rules.
prompt: Filter anecdotal claims: Verify whether personal anecdotes or isolated success stories are improperly framed as universal principles, and add appropriate boundary conditions.

name: Expert Quote Integration
desc: Seamlessly integrates high-signal citations from domain authorities.
explain: Seamlessly integrates high-signal citations from domain authorities.
prompt: Integrate expert commentary: Embed 2 direct, high-impact quotes or viewpoints from recognized domain authorities or primary researchers.

name: Counter-Evidence Inspection
desc: Transparently acknowledges and addresses data contradicting the thesis.
explain: Transparently acknowledges and addresses data contradicting the thesis.
prompt: Inspect counter-evidence: Identify the strongest empirical finding that challenges the central thesis and transparently evaluate its implications to fortify the argument.

name: Steelman Counter-Arguments
desc: Engages with reader skepticism in its most rigorous and persuasive form.
explain: Engages with reader skepticism in its most rigorous and persuasive form.
prompt: Steelman counter-arguments: Present the top 2 opposing objections at their strongest, acknowledge valid concerns, and demonstrate why the primary thesis remains sound.

name: Dialectic Synthesis Flow
desc: Structures the narrative through Thesis, Antithesis, and Synthesis.
explain: Structures the narrative through Thesis, Antithesis, and Synthesis.
prompt: Construct a dialectical body flow: (a) Dominant Convention (Thesis), (b) Friction Point & Critique (Antithesis), (c) Integrated Resolution (Synthesis).

name: Nuance Injector
desc: Enriches binary claims with contextual boundaries and trade-offs.
explain: Enriches binary claims with contextual boundaries and trade-offs.
prompt: Inject intellectual nuance: Instead of claiming absolute efficacy, explicitly articulate the edge cases, resource trade-offs, and conditions where this approach fails.

name: Cognitive Dissonance Arc
desc: Challenges existing reader assumptions to spark critical engagement.
explain: Challenges existing reader assumptions to spark critical engagement.
prompt: Engineer a cognitive dissonance arc: Reveal how an intuitive, well-regarded practice may inadvertently cause negative downstream side-effects.

name: Paradox Resolution Narrative
desc: Resolves core industry contradictions through a coherent mental model.
explain: Resolves core industry contradictions through a coherent mental model.
prompt: Identify and resolve the central industry paradox: Clarify competing tensions and present a structured mental model that reconciles both sides.

name: Multi-Perspective Matrix
desc: Evaluates the subject across developer, executive, and user viewpoints.
explain: Evaluates the subject across developer, executive, and user viewpoints.
prompt: Assemble a multi-perspective matrix: Evaluate the topic through 3 distinct vantage points (e.g. Engineering, Executive Leadership, End User) in parallel.

name: Outline Architect & WRITING NOTES (BLOG.md)
desc: Builds an outline with [WRITING NOTE: Tone/Goal] directives under every heading.
explain: Builds an outline with [WRITING NOTE: Tone/Goal] directives under every heading.
prompt: Generate a BLOG.md standard outline: Under every H2/H3 section header, insert bracketed directives: `[WRITING NOTE: Data to cite, target tone, and specific clichés to avoid]`.

name: Section Transition & Pacing
desc: Maintains reader momentum with balanced analytical and rhythmic transitions.
explain: Maintains reader momentum with balanced analytical and rhythmic transitions.
prompt: Tune section pacing: Bridge lengthy analytical paragraphs with crisp, high-impact transitional sentences that maintain narrative momentum.

name: Minto Pyramid Principle
desc: Delivers core conclusions upfront before unpacking supporting arguments.
explain: Delivers core conclusions upfront before unpacking supporting arguments.
prompt: Apply the Minto Pyramid Principle: State the core takeaway or answer in the opening sentence of each section, followed by structured supporting evidence.

name: Skimmability & Visual Formatting
desc: Enhances readability using selective bolding, bullet points, and callouts.
explain: Enhances readability using selective bolding, bullet points, and callouts.
prompt: Format for skimmability: Bold key conceptual terms sparingly, convert dense lists to bullets, and enclose central takeaways inside markdown `> Callout Blocks`.

name: Executive Summary (TL;DR) Box
desc: Summarizes the entire article into a 3-bullet high-signal executive overview.
explain: Summarizes the entire article into a 3-bullet high-signal executive overview.
prompt: Create an upfront '3-Sentence Executive Summary (TL;DR)' box enabling busy readers to grasp the entire argument in under 10 seconds.

name: Analytical Conclusion & Call-to-Action
desc: Concludes with an intellectual discussion prompt or structured next step.
explain: Concludes with an intellectual discussion prompt or structured next step.
prompt: Craft a high-signal conclusion: Replace generic sales calls-to-action with a thoughtful discussion prompt or actionable implementation checklist.

name: Pop-Culture & AI Cliché Filter
desc: Eliminates empty marketing buzzwords like 'game-changer', 'delve', and 'unpack'.
explain: Eliminates empty marketing buzzwords like 'game-changer', 'delve', and 'unpack'.
prompt: Purge all marketing clichés and AI buzzwords: Ban phrases like 'game-changer', 'revolutionary', 'delve into', 'unpack', and 'the future is here'.

name: Synthetic AI Pattern Scrubber
desc: Breaks robotic transition formulas and overly symmetrical paragraph structures.
explain: Breaks robotic transition formulas and overly symmetrical paragraph structures.
prompt: Strip AI writing artifacts: Reduce robotic boilerplate transitions ('Furthermore', 'In conclusion', 'Moreover') and vary paragraph lengths naturally.

name: Fluff & Filler Sentence Pruner
desc: Cuts hollow filler sentences that do not contribute substantive information.
explain: Cuts hollow filler sentences that do not contribute substantive information.
prompt: Prune filler: Strip zero-information fluff sentences, tightening and concentrating the overall prose density by at least 20%.

name: Passive to Active Voice Converter
desc: Converts sluggish passive sentence constructions into dynamic active verbs.
explain: Converts sluggish passive sentence constructions into dynamic active verbs.
prompt: Convert passive phrasing into crisp active verbs to maximize energy and directness (e.g. 'Mistakes were made by the team' -> 'The team made mistakes').

name: Clickbait Neutralizer
desc: Aligns exaggerated headlines and claims with complete editorial integrity.
explain: Aligns exaggerated headlines and claims with complete editorial integrity.
prompt: Neutralize clickbait: Align all titles, subtitles, and introductory promises with what the text genuinely proves and delivers.

name: Tautology & Redundancy Purger
desc: Condenses repetitive paragraphs expressing the same thought into a single point.
explain: Condenses repetitive paragraphs expressing the same thought into a single point.
prompt: Purge tautology and redundancy: Identify paragraphs restating the same idea with different vocabulary and condense them into a single focused sentence.
